entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I can't believe his interrogation was[n]part of such an elaborate plot...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: He is truly no ordinary child.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He is our leader, after all.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Though I can't say it was easy.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Not at all. It was tense just hearing his[n]explanation of what happened.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I'm sure he knew the arrest wouldn't be[n]pleasant, but the drugs may have been[n]a factor even he didn't expect.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yeah... I'm not sure what we would've[n]done if he hadn't pulled through.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm gettin' some baaad vibes from this[n]place. He was stuck in here the entire[n]time, right...?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Despite the violence and scare tactics he[n]endured, he still managed to carry out[n]the plan with aplomb... How admirable.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I hear that guy had quite a time in there.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I know he was a suspect in a serious[n]case, but... he's just a kid. Wish they'd[n]gone a lil easier on him.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Our interrogation tactics clearly went[n]too far.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I agree with you. It's unacceptable.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...A little late to say that now, though.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, don't worry about it. I know it[n]wasn't your fault.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: How nostalgic... It makes me sick to[n]remember that day.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I can't believe I was so thoroughly tricked.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It was quite a gamble on our end.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But ultimately, our justice saw the light.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Justice, huh... Sure, let's leave it at that.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: It's rather surprising that you went as far[n]as involving me in your grand scheme.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: What would you have done if you[n]failed to get me on your side?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We couldn't fail! We had the power of[n]friendship!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes... We believed in both you and our[n]leader.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Heh... That's quite a concept.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Every time I see an interrogation room,[n]I think about the katsudon that officers[n]serve in there.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Likewise.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Though I'd never wish to be arrested,[n]I've always wondered what it would[n]be like to partake in that meal.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Does it taste better? Smell better? And[n]most importantly, is it free?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, that's not a real thing. It only[n]happens in crime dramas and stuff.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Impossible... So it was but a dream?[n]Nothing but a fragment of society's[n]twisted imagination...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You're overreacting.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Another lifelong dream, crushed for Inari.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Who the hell beat up our leader? Was it[n]the cops? The lawyers?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We need to return the favor.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't, Ryuji. Our plan worked. It's over,[n]we took down all the bad guys.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Besides, something tells me he's not[n]looking for revenge.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hm... Yeah, you're probably right.
